**Pomeran Bank - Account statements**

As a holder of a Pomeran Bank account, you will receive monthly statements of your account activity. Our representative will be calling you within the next few days to inquire whether you would like statements sent to you by e-mail or delivered to you by postal mail. Please decide which of these two options suits you better. Statements are free of charge. A fee of $5.00 is charged if the balance on your account falls below $100.

Additionally, you can access your account information on our Website. Pomeran Bank is proud of its online services. We store records of your account activity for five years, while most other banks store the information for only two to three years.

reading.originalPassage:
**Waitakere Zoo**

January 22

Dear Mr. McBride,

On behalf of the Friends of the Waitakere Zoo, I thank you for your donation. Your generosity, along with that of other donors, has enabled us to complete construction on the African Savannah enclosure. When it opens in July, the enclosure will provide our antelope, giraffe, and zebra populations an environment that is more similar to their natural habitat than zoo enclosures typically are. Moreover, it will give visitors a better vantage from which to view these beautiful creatures.

We are pleased to inform you that your name will be listed with the names of other donors on a commemorative plaque at the entrance to the African Savannah enclosure. As a further token of our appreciation, please accept a full season pass, which will allow you and one guest to enter at no charge. It will arrive this week in a separate letter.

Sincerely,
Joseph Ihimaera
Associate Director
reading.completedPassage:
Waitakere Zoo thanks Mr. McBride for his donation to the African Savannah enclosure. The enclosure will improve animal habitats and visitor viewing access. Mr. McBride will receive a season pass.

**Dịch:** Sở thú Waitakere gửi thư cảm ơn ông McBride vì khoản quyên góp cho khu chuồng African Savannah. Khu chuồng mới sẽ tạo môi trường sống giống tự nhiên hơn cho linh dương, hươu cao cổ và ngựa vằn, đồng thời giúp khách tham quan quan sát tốt hơn. Ông McBride sẽ nhận được vé mùa cho ông và một khách đi kèm.

**The Manor at Aldous Street**

Parkhurst's newest apartment building offers city life at its most comfortable and convenient. The Manor at Aldous Street has a wide array of shops and fine restaurants just outside its door. For daily commuters to the city center, public transportation is available at the Queens Landing station, just a short walk to the north.

Our apartment units range from one to three bedrooms. Each unit has a full-sized kitchen with a refrigerator, oven, and dishwashing machine, a dining room separate from the kitchen, and a spacious sitting room with balcony access. Residents also have access to complimentary high-speed Internet, shared laundry facilities, and, for an additional monthly fee, the parking garage.

Call Henman Estate Agents at 0430-555-0108 to schedule an appointment. Visit our Web site for apartment floor plans, photos of the building, and a map of the Parkhurst neighborhood. Units will be available beginning on April 1.
reading.completedPassage:
The Manor at Aldous Street is a new apartment building in a convenient neighborhood with nearby restaurants and public transportation. Units include appliances, separate dining rooms, balcony access, and high-speed Internet.

**Dịch:** The Manor at Aldous Street là một tòa căn hộ mới nằm trong khu phố thuận tiện, gần nhiều cửa hàng, nhà hàng và phương tiện công cộng. Các căn hộ có thiết bị nhà bếp, phòng ăn riêng, lối ra ban công và Internet tốc độ cao miễn phí. Khách có thể gọi điện để đặt lịch xem căn hộ.

**Passenger Check-in**

Air Albion asks that you allow yourself ample time to board your flight. Passenger check-in and security screening are subject to unexpected and sometimes lengthy delays. Please arrive at the airport at least one hour before scheduled departure for flights within the United Kingdom, 90 minutes before flights from the UK to Ireland, and two hours before flights from the UK to international destinations other than Ireland.

Valid government-issued photo identification is required at check-in. The name on the ID must match the name in which the reservation was made.

Your reservation is subject to cancellation and additional rescheduling fees if you are not checked in and present at the boarding gate at least 10 minutes before domestic flights and flights between the UK and Ireland, and at least 25 minutes before all other international flights. Domestic flights and flights between the UK and Ireland do not require confirmation. For all other international flights, confirm your reservation at least 24 hours before departure.
reading.completedPassage:
Air Albion asks passengers to arrive early because check-in and security screening times can vary. Passengers flying from the UK to Ireland should arrive 90 minutes early. Other international flights require confirmation 24 hours before departure.

**Dịch:** Air Albion yêu cầu hành khách đến sân bay sớm vì thời gian làm thủ tục và kiểm tra an ninh có thể thay đổi nhiều. Hành khách bay từ Vương quốc Anh đến Ireland nên đến trước 90 phút. Các chuyến bay quốc tế khác ngoài Ireland cần được xác nhận ít nhất 24 giờ trước giờ khởi hành.
